expectations.evidence: Format choices are driven by fit-to-objective rather than cost: the matrix maps each placement to a source by what performs there (cold scroll wants native/UGC feel; warm/retargeting 'tolerates and often prefers polished brand footage'), and it explicitly warns 'don't over-index on UGC just because it's trendy.'
